description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
是否强制重启：

- true：强制，
- false（默认）：不强制
description.en:
Specifies whether to force restart the instance. Valid values:

- true: force restart
- false (default): do not force restart.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch restart-logstash --instance-id ls-cn-v0h1kzca0000 --biz-force true --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --batch-count 20.0 --restart-type instance --nodes 192.168.1.1 --node-types kibana --blue-green-dep false --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
